frases.texto: Your TV remote turns the soundbar up, and it never points at it.
That little light hits the TV, and it stops.
The order runs down one wire, inside the cable.
You press volume. The TV whispers. The bar gets loud.
Swap that cable for an optical one, and the same press does nothing.
That one carries sound as a red light. It has no wire for orders.
The first remote was a wire across the floor, and people tripped on it.
So they cut the wire. Then only the TV could hear you.
The wire came back, hidden inside the picture cable.
Now your phone is the remote.
The app is in the link in bio.
Send it to that friend who still aims at the soundbar.
